description: Add global regex cache and lazy lowercase input cache

asi.hypothesis: Regex recompilation per evaluate() and repeated to_lowercase() on input are the main bottlenecks.
asi.changes: 1. Replaced per-evaluation regex cache with a thread-local global cache. 2. Added lazy lowercase cache in Ctx to avoid repeated to_lowercase() calls for case-insensitive contains.
asi.result: Massive improvement: keyword -91.8%, regex -92.4%. Total from 392µs to 34µs.

description: Cache stemmers per-language and avoid double-lowercase in language detection

asi.hypothesis: Stemmer creation and redundant lowercasing in detect_language are micro-optimizations that help semantic workloads.
asi.changes: 1. Use OnceLock to cache English/Spanish stemmers. 2. Pass pre-lowercased string to tokenize in detect_language. 3. Remove dead contains() helper.
asi.result: No significant change on current benchmarks (within noise), but removes redundant work and caches expensive stemmer construction.
